claims.quote: the Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe
claims.statement: The Scottish Government is one of the most centralised devolved administrations in Europe.

claims.statement: Holyrood does not give people who know their areas best enough of a say.

claims.quote: despite significant devolution from Westminster over the last 27 years
claims.statement: Despite significant devolution from Westminster over the last 27 years, Holyrood does not give enough say to local people.

claims.statement: The next stage of devolution should place more decision-making in Scotland’s regions and cities to drive reindustrialisation.

claims.statement: Power was never supposed to stop at the doors of the Scottish Parliament.

claims.statement: People in North Lanarkshire, Fife and the Highlands know what their communities need better than any minister, whether in London or Edinburgh.
